scope: Five missing lookup routes, explicitly named with the same charging bands in both November and December 2026 original notices. This is a surcharge lookup review, not a flight schedule or seat availability check.

existingMapReview.result: No charging-band conflict found for matching named KE/OZ routes already present in OFFICIAL_ROUTE_MAP. Five omitted routes added.
limitations: Official tables list major routes, not an exhaustive operating schedule; old routes absent from December examples were not deleted.
ULN/UBN and CTU/TFU city-to-airport aliases were not reclassified by this narrow review.
No unverified numeric mileage was added for UKB or YNZ. Official route bands determine the lookup.
